Maya: Quick pulse — weekly GPU capacity snapshot attached. TL;DR: US‑west burn around 14k GPU‑hrs (+6% w/w), EU maintenance Fri–Sun cuts ~22% capacity, APAC demand spike from partner trial (~+2.5k GPU‑hrs). Notable: sfo-cluster-3 seeing network-induced evictions (~10%) which may push p99 up. Need short-term mitigation decisions.
Oliver: Can you drop per-cluster numbers here? need to see SFO/EWR/FRA/SIN to decide shifts.
Samir: Quick table from the forecast pipeline:
```
US‑west (sfo): available 14,000h  projected usage 12,600h
US‑east (ewr): available 9,000h   projected usage 8,800h
EU (fra): available 7,500h       projected usage 5,900h (maint Fri–Sun)
APAC (sin): available 4,200h     projected usage 6,400h (partner trial)
```
Maya: SFO evictions traced to noisy NIC firmware 10.2.1 on a subset of blades. Infra testing rollback now. If rollback fails, plan B = shift ~20% canary traffic to EWR + temporarily increase batch density in EWR to keep unit cost.
Jonah: Cost note — shifting 20% to EWR ups cost ~5% (on‑demand premium) but keeps p99 and throughput stable. Prefered vs risking evictions.
Priya: Can we throttle noncritical APAC spot jobs to free headroom? partner SLA is flexible for the trial window.
capacity-bot: automated-alert: predicted US‑west spot preemption spike 03/21 04:00–07:00 UTC, expected +8% preemptions. See burn model link: https://redwood.internal/capacity/burn
Maya: Action items: 1) Infra to confirm rollback by EOD @Samir; 2) Prod to run 20% canary shift test 10:30 PT @Jonah; 3) Ops to prep eviction mitigation playbook + rollback plan @Oliver. Also consider throttling APAC spot as Priya suggested.
Oliver: scheduling the canary. tagging oncall network. Also enabling aggressive local KV cache to shave some token compute for affected LLM routes.
Jonah: lgtm. I'll set transient batch_size=8 (was 16) for LLM routes hitting sfo for the next 24h.
Samir: starting firmware rollback to 10.2.0 on sfo-cluster-3 now (rolling). ETA 20m, will post results here.
Maya: thanks all — I'll update the weekly deck and post final numbers in #eng-infra tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
